description: When the only candidate is out of stock, the item is skipped and no basket line is added.

input.userMessage: Shop 'truffle' where the only candidate is out of stock.

expectedBehavior.outputFormat: JSON BasketResult with an empty Lines array.
expectedBehavior.decisionCriteria: An out-of-stock-only search must add nothing and leave the basket empty for that item.

scoring.passCriteria: No basket line is produced for the unavailable item.
